scope: Contact onsets from saved rigid poses with exact scene outlines, calibrated on training simulator references and checked on validation; original model, scorer thresholds and historical scores unchanged. Optional frozen D028 id_test is descriptive only, with no selection or gate changes.
onset_rule: interval i: outlines separated at frame i and within the touch threshold at frame i+1
held_out_scope: Descriptive only: frozen D028 checkpoints and plans, touch threshold chosen on training clips before reading them; no selection or gate.

limitations: Exact outlines come from the scene specification: evaluation-only ground truth, as labels are.
Circles and rectangles only; triangles occur only in the shape-OOD split.
This binary touch-edge rule does not identify onsets without a sampled gap-to-touch transition.
Timing is conditional on detected contact; occurrence and timed denominators remain reported.
Model samples use four references; leave-one-out reference comparisons use three.
A canonical zero-force reference has no leave-one-out peer and is unscorable for reference occurrence.
Validation first-contact timing uses eight collision conditions; held-out D018 adds twenty on ten fresh ID scenes.

projection_standoff_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic over contact conditions; changes no score.
